originalTitle: Show HN: Edi Life OS – self-hosted life dashboard with an MCP server for AI
content:
One self-hosted home for your focus, habits, goals, money and projects — with an MCP server so your AI assistant can work alongside you.

Quick start · Tour · AI / MCP · Deploy · API

Most of us run our lives across a to-do app, a habit tracker, a budgeting spreadsheet, a Pomodoro timer and a notes app — and none of them know about each other. Edi Life OS puts all of it in one calm, private dashboard and connects the small things you do today to the direction you want your life to take.

Growth — Six life dimensions, each linked to long-term goals, SMART goals, habits and tasks. Guided weekly, monthly and quarterly reviews.

Focus — Pomodoro sessions with breaks, a built-in focus soundtrack and a landscape that follows the time of day.

Habittify — Small daily habits, streaks and a seven-day picture of your consistency.

Kanban — Boards with labels, priorities, due dates, checklists, comments and attachments.

Dates follow Asia/Tehran . The weather card shows Qeshm Island via Open-Meteo; its tide figure is a modeled estimate, not for navigation.

Edi Life OS ships with an optional MCP server that exposes 26 tools across your dashboard, goals, tasks, habits, finances and notes. Connect it to Claude Desktop, Claude Code or any MCP client and ask in plain language:

"Create a SMART goal called Build a home studio, due in three months, and add Buy acoustic panels as a task."

"Log a 450,000 Toman food expense and show my balance."

The MCP server talks to your app only through its token-protected HTTP API. It never touches your database or credentials. Setup takes a minute — see MCP server below.

Open localhost:8080 and sign in. MySQL, the app and your attachments each live in their own volume, so docker compose up -d --build after a git pull upgrades without losing data.

Download lifeos- .zip from the latest release and extract it into your hosting home directory , so public_html/ becomes your web root and the backend sits safely above it. Copy config.example.php to config.php , fill in your MySQL details, and open your site. See the deployment guide for details.

You need PHP 8.1+ (with pdo_mysql and mbstring ) and MySQL 8+ (or MariaDB 10.4+).

Edit config.php with your database connection and the username and password you want to sign in with, then start the server:

Open localhost:8000 and sign in. The database and tables are created on first use. You can change your sign-in later in Settings .

config.php and .env hold real credentials and are gitignored. Never commit them.

A private /api/v1 API covers the dashboard, goals, tasks, habits, finances and sticky notes. It uses its own bearer token, separate from your browser sign-in.

Set the result as api_token in config.php (or the LIFEOS_API_TOKEN environment variable), then:

See the API reference for endpoints, payloads and errors.

The server runs over stdio ; there is no hosted MCP endpoint. The MCP guide lists every tool and shows client configuration for Claude and Codex.

Moving from the old Habittify SQLite database? See migrating Habittify .

Edi Life OS is built for a single owner .

Built with PHP, MySQL and vanilla JavaScript — no frontend build step, no framework.

Dockerfile , docker-compose.yml and docker/config.php run the app with configuration from environment variables.

MIT © 2026 Edris Ranjbar. Use it, fork it and build on it.

Ideas, bug reports and pull requests are welcome. Open an issue to start a conversation, and see the development guide to run the checks locally.

If Edi Life OS helps you run your days, consider giving it a ⭐ — it helps others find it.
chineseTitle: Show HN：Edi Life OS – 带有用于 AI 的 MCP 服务器的自托管生活仪表板
chineseContent:
一个自托管的家，可容纳您的注意力、习惯、目标、金钱和项目 - 配有 MCP 服务器，以便您的 AI 助手可以与您一起工作。

快速入门 · 导览 · AI / MCP · 部署 · API

我们大多数人的生活都是通过待办事项应用程序、习惯追踪器、预算电子表格、番茄钟计时器和笔记应用程序进行的，而它们彼此都不了解。 Edi Life OS 将所有这些都集中在一个平静、私密的仪表板中，并将您今天所做的小事与您想要的生活方向联系起来。

成长——六个生活维度，每个维度都与长期目标、SMART 目标、习惯和任务相关。指导性每周、每月和季度回顾。

专注 — 带有休息时间的番茄工作法、内置的专注音轨和跟随一天时间的风景。

Habittify — 日常小习惯、连续记录以及 7 天的坚持情况。

看板——带有标签、优先级、截止日期、清单、评论和附件的看板。

日期遵循亚洲/德黑兰。天气卡通过 Open-Meteo 显示格什姆岛；其潮汐图是模型估计值，不用于导航。

Edi Life OS 附带可选的 MCP 服务器，可在您的仪表板、目标、任务、习惯、财务和笔记中公开 26 种工具。将其连接到 Claude Desktop、Claude Code 或任何 MCP 客户端，并用简单的语言询问：

“创建一个名为“建立家庭工作室”的 SMART 目标，三个月内到期，并将“购买隔音板”添加为一项任务。”

“记录 450,000 托曼的食品费用并显示我的余额。”

MCP 服务器仅通过其受令牌保护的 HTTP API 与您的应用程序进行通信。它永远不会触及您的数据库或凭据。设置需要一分钟时间 — 请参阅下面的 MCP 服务器。

打开 localhost:8080 并登录。MySQL、应用程序和附件都位于自己的卷中，因此 docker compose up -d --build 在 git pull 升级后不会丢失数据。

从最新版本下载 lifeos-.zip 并将其解压到您的托管主目录中，这样 public_html/ 就成为您的 Web 根目录，并且后端安全地位于其上方。将 config.example.php 复制到 config.php ，填写您的 MySQL 详细信息，然后打开您的站点。详细信息请参见部署指南。

您需要 PHP 8.1+（带有 pdo_mysql 和 mbstring ）和 MySQL 8+（或 MariaDB 10.4+）。

使用您的数据库连接以及您想要登录的用户名和密码编辑 config.php，然后启动服务器：

打开 localhost:8000 并登录。数据库和表是在第一次使用时创建的。您可以稍后在“设置”中更改登录信息。

config.php 和 .env 拥有真实的凭据并且被 gitignored。永远不要犯下这些错误。

私有 /api/v1 API 涵盖仪表板、目标、任务、习惯、财务和便签。它使用自己的不记名令牌，与您的浏览器登录分开。

将结果设置为config.php中的api_token（或LIFEOS_API_TOKEN环境变量），然后：

请参阅 API 参考以了解端点、有效负载和错误。

服务器在 stdio 上运行；没有托管 MCP 端点。 MCP 指南列出了每个工具并显示了 Claude 和 Codex 的客户端配置。

从旧的 Habittify SQLite 数据库迁移？请参阅迁移 Habittify 。

Edi Life OS 是为单一所有者构建的。

使用 PHP、MySQL 和 vanilla JavaScript 构建 - 没有前端构建步骤，没有框架。

Dockerfile 、 docker-compose.yml 和 docker/config.php 使用环境变量中的配置运行应用程序。

欢迎提出想法、错误报告和拉取请求。打开问题以开始对话，并查看开发指南以在本地运行检查。

如果 Edi Life OS 帮助您度过每一天，请考虑给它一个 ⭐——它可以帮助其他人找到它。
